kicker: A cost plugin, read and measured

scenes.headline: How TokenEconomizer trims a coding agent's bill
scenes.sub: A Microsoft plugin for Claude Code and Codex, read file by file
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pim! A new plugin promises cheaper Claude Code and Codex without touching the agent. Here is where it sits, and what it can cut.

params.row: each row is one turn's request
params.cut: a smaller tools block, on every turn
params.resumed: resumed after the tools changed: all written again

steps.say: Every agent turn sends the tools, the system prompt, the task and the whole history. The next turn sends it all again, plus a little more.

steps.term: Prompt cache: a re-sent prefix billed at a discount
steps.say: The cache makes the repeat cheap, not free. The old part is read at a tenth of the price, the new tail is written.
So a tool the agent never calls is still paid for, on every turn. Remove it, and every row gets shorter.
One case hurts. Resume a conversation after its tools changed, and the whole history is written to the cache again.
The authors' picture: each finished session teaches the plugin one thing.

steps.caption: A schematic, not data
steps.say: Remember how the repo works, skip tools never used, and step in when a turn loops.
It is not a proxy. Nothing rewrites requests. At session start, a hook adds a few learned facts.
After each tool call, a loop guard watches for repeated failures and may attach a short redirect.
When the session ends, it reads the agent's own log and updates what it knows.
Unused tools go into a deny list in the repo's settings, seen only by the next session.
In the paper's harness, a stuck run was restarted with a fresh conversation, then aborted. The plugin never does that.

states.say: On the benchmark, a judge masked nineteen tools on Claude Code.
The plugin protects eleven of them, because a person asks questions, plans, and spawns sub-agents. It may prune eight.

scenes.title: Tool JSON, Claude Code 2.1.307
scenes.note: Captured against a fake API, no model calls
scenes.say: I captured what a current Claude Code sends. It already defers most tools. The plugin's list still drops two big ones.

steps.say: On the benchmark, the full stack was cheaper in every repository and setting, with task success within noise.

left.title: The paper
left.say: But the measured stack had learned facts switched on, the wider mask, and restarts.

right.title: The plugin
items: A note, then a message to you
right.say: The plugin ships facts off, prunes fewer tools, and only nudges.

scenes.text: Worth installing in repos you use daily. Trust its own ledger, not the paper's percentage.
scenes.say: Worth installing in the repos you use every day. Then trust its own cost ledger, not the paper's headline.

recap: Hooks and settings, not a proxy
scenes.say: Hooks, not a proxy. Careful with the cache. A smaller cut than the headline. Thanks for watching!
